surfaceflinger_failure.meaning: GraphicBufferMapper tried Gralloc5, Gralloc4, Gralloc3 and Gralloc2 in that order and every mapper object reported not loaded. The fatal is not a Mali-renderer result.

api_order: Gralloc5: AIDL allocator v2 plus stable-C mapper.<suffix>.so; not supplied by the retained vendor
Gralloc2: android.hardware.graphics.mapper@2.0::IMapper/default with optional cast to 2.1; retained path
exact_runtime_path.transport_resolution: system/libhidl/transport/ServiceManagement.cpp:897-992 asks hwservicemanager getTransport(descriptor, instance); the exact vendor manifest returns PASSTHROUGH
call_graph: GraphicBufferMapper tries Gralloc5 -> Gralloc4 -> Gralloc3 -> Gralloc2
hwservicemanager reports PASSTHROUGH from @2.1 IMapper/default manifest entry
android_load_sphal_library attempts the installed mapper in the sphal namespace
Bionic eager relocation fails before HIDL_FETCH_IMapper can run
Gralloc2 remains unloaded; all generations are absent; GraphicBufferMapper aborts

linker_namespace.loader: system/core/libvndksupport/linker.cpp:64-75 uses android_dlopen_ext with the exported sphal namespace
linker_namespace.why_system_symbol_cannot_rescue_vendor_d: libc++.so is exposed from the vndk link to sphal, not from the default link; namespace isolation therefore selects the VNDK31 snapshot for the vendor DSO.

r6_provider_failure.relocation_semantics: Bionic linker.cpp:2989 states RTLD_LAZY is unsupported; linker_relocate.cpp:121-124 rejects an unresolved non-weak symbol with 'cannot locate symbol'. The mapper therefore fails at dlopen before dlsym/HIDL_FETCH_IMapper.
r6_provider_failure.downstream_boundary: Even after mapper relocation is corrected, hw_get_module opens gralloc.apollo.so with RTLD_NOW; the r6 gralloc has the same sole missing symbol. Both ARM64 files are inseparable parts of this one instantiation closure.

canonical_remediation.mechanism: Use libc++'s documented _LIBCPP_VERBOSE_ABORT customization hook to preserve abort semantics without importing the post-VNDK31 shared-library symbol.
canonical_remediation.mapper_source_delta: ARM64 cflag pre-includes vndk31_libcpp_backdeploy.h for the exact r7 passthrough mapper module.
canonical_remediation.gralloc_source_delta: LOCAL_CPPFLAGS_64 pre-includes the same bounded header for gralloc.apollo; ARM32 candidate bytes remain the frozen r6 control.
canonical_remediation.behavioral_scope: Only libc++ fatal diagnostics lose formatted text; the path remains fatal. Normal mapper/gralloc behavior and interfaces are unchanged.

r7_decision.why_two_files_are_one_cause: They are sequential, same-process parts of the same HIDL mapper factory: the mapper must relocate before its fetch function runs, then that fetch function must load gralloc with RTLD_NOW. Both old files fail on the same single VNDK31 libc++ symbol.
